questions.stem: A survey records the number of goals scored in football matches. This data is:
questions.explanation: The number of goals can only take whole-number values ($0, 1, 2, 3, ...$). Data that can only take specific values (usually integers) is discrete.

questions.stem: Which statement about primary and secondary data is correct?

options.text: Primary data is always more accurate than secondary data
Primary data is collected first-hand; secondary data is collected by someone else
Secondary data is always from the internet
Primary data is qualitative; secondary data is quantitative

questions.explanation: Primary data is data you collect yourself (e.g. through surveys or experiments). Secondary data has been collected by someone else and may come from databases, books, or the internet.
